dynamic_rules.insurance_reports.r02.d01: compare_fee_schedule_id (entity_single, lookup:fee_schedules) has enabled_when include_ucr == true and required_when include_ucr == true (shared rule of 04, inferred); while include_ucr is false the control is greyed and its value is replaced by disabled_value null. Office Default prints the fee of the line's code on the chosen schedule in force on the service date when include_ucr is ticked, and 0.00 while it is unticked (the 2008 default sample prints 0.00 on every row; reading inferred, FLT-23). No extra column is added; the chosen schedule is named in the criteria echo.

actions.CREATE TASK: Bulk action create_tasks (kind create_task, scope bulk, entity claim, id_column claim_id): after a confirmation that states the number of claims of the run, writes one follow-up per claim of the snapshot, typed outstanding_claim (claim_kind = claims) or outstanding_pre_auth (claim_kind = pre_authorization); the follow-up closes itself when the claim's status_class becomes paid, closed, denied, void or deleted. Idempotent per (run_id, action_key, claim_id). Store: worklist_followups of 06 section 6.7 (DASH-28), dispatch ENG-49, authorisation SEC-36, all P3 in their owning documents: RPT-INS-07 raises a cross-document re-phase request to 02 / 06 / 08 for the snapshot bulk dispatch, the minimal follow-up store and the action authorisation in P2 (blocking dependency). If the request is refused, CREATE TASK ships in P3 and is listed as a known P2 parity gap. Feature right of the task store, not the report right.

dynamic_rules.insurance_reports.r08.d01: group_by has enabled_when ["not_in", "output_format", ["xlsx", "csv"]] (documented for Excel; csv, added as an enhancement, behaves like xlsx): with output_format = xlsx or csv both options are greyed and the value is replaced by disabled_value none, so the workbook is the flat one-row-per-claim sheet. output_format is declared with role query on this report (04 section 8), so switching PDF / Excel re-runs the report instead of re-rendering the snapshot.

dynamic_rules.insurance_reports.r12.d01: report_format has enabled_when ["not_in", "output_format", ["xlsx", "csv"]] and forced_when [{when: ["in", "output_format", ["xlsx", "csv"]], value: detail}] (documented for Excel; csv, added as an enhancement, behaves like xlsx): the report opens with output_format = xlsx (legacy default kept), so both REPORT FORMAT options are greyed with Detail marked; choosing pdf enables both options (detail / summary). A summary sent together with xlsx or csv is replaced by detail and reported in warnings[]. output_format has role query on this report.
